labels_origin: expert-human: labelled by the agent acting as localization expert from source+target only, before any judge output was seen. Two strata: `random` = uniform sample of STATE_TRANSLATED QA units (natural base rate), `check-enriched` = units with an open Weblate check, re-judged independently (the check name was never treated as the label). Label `stale_source` = the target is right and the ru source is the outlier, proven by cross-language agreement in the QA corpus: these records are excluded from recall and false-flag scoring, because flagging them is not a translation defect.
